title: . pipeline parameters
description: Creating a GO database for a model organism

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment. Required unless --input_tree and --input_orthogroups are both provided and neither --run_eggnog nor --stats is set.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

max_job_request_options.title: Max job request options
max_job_request_options.description: Set the top limit for requested resources for any single job.
max_job_request_options.help_text:
If you are running on a smaller system, a pipeline step requesting more resources than are available may cause the Nextflow to stop the run with an error. These options allow you to cap the maximum resources requested by any single job so that the pipeline will run on your system.

Note that you can not _increase_ the resources requested by any job using these options. For that you will need your own configuration file. See [the nf-core website](https://nf-co.re/usage/configuration) for details.

max_cpus.description: Maximum number of CPUs that can be requested for any single job.
max_cpus.help_text: Use to set an upper-limit for the CPU requirement for each process. Should be an integer e.g. `--max_cpus 1`

max_memory.description: Maximum amount of memory that can be requested for any single job.
max_memory.help_text: Use to set an upper-limit for the memory requirement for each process. Should be a string in the format integer-unit e.g. `--max_memory '8.GB'`

max_time.description: Maximum amount of time that can be requested for any single job.
max_time.help_text: Use to set an upper-limit for the time requirement for each process. Should be a string in the format integer-unit e.g. `--max_time '2.h'`

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

ncbi_max_forks.description: Number of NCBIGENOMEDOWNLOAD tasks to run concurrently. Each parses the full NCBI assembly summary for its taxonomic group, so a lower value can be faster on a laptop (see -profile mac); raise it on a cluster.

forks.description: Maximum number of each process that will be run in parallel

architecture.description: An amd or arm value assigned to this parameter determines whether containers built for the amd or arm CPU architecture are used

custom_config.description: A path/url to a custom configuration file

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

ensembl_dataset.description: A path to a file containing a list of ensembl biomart dataset names separated by newline

predownloaded_fasta.description: A path to a folder containing a singular or multiple fasta files for each species you wish to use for GO assignment

predownloaded_gofiles.description: Path to a folder containing pre-computed gene-to-GO mapping files (one per species), as an alternative to running EggNOG-mapper. Each file must be named {species_id}.go.txt and contain two tab-separated columns: gene_id and GO term (one pair per line, e.g. 'geneA\tGO:0006412'). Multiple GO terms for the same gene are given on separate lines.

chromo_go.description: A flag to optionally choose to run GO analysis on each chromosome

go_expansion.description: A flag optionally choose to run a basic expansion/contraction analysis

skip_cafe.description: A flag to skip the cafe section. Used if you just wish to run go assignment for a species without runnig Cafe

input_tree.description: Path to a pre-computed rooted species tree in Newick format (e.g. SpeciesTree_rooted_node_labels.txt from a previous OrthoFinder run). Providing this together with --input_orthogroups skips the slow OrthoFinder step.

input_orthogroups.description: Path to a pre-computed Orthogroups.tsv from a previous OrthoFinder run. Must be provided together with --input_tree to skip OrthoFinder.

orthofinder_blast_results.description: Path to a pre-computed blast WorkingDirectory produced by a previous ORTHOFINDER_BLAST run (saved to results/orthofinder_blast/). Skips the DIAMOND search step and runs only orthogroup inference and phylogeny. Useful for resuming after a failed phylogeny stage or re-running with different tree-inference options.

groups.description: A string with NCBI taxonomic groups to download. Can be a comma-separated list. Options are [‘all’, ‘archaea’, ‘bacteria’, ‘fungi’, ‘invertebrate’, ‘metagenomes’, ‘plant’, ‘protozoa’, ‘vertebrate_mammalian’, ‘vertebrate_other’, ‘viral’]

stats.description: A flag to run statistics and other quality checks on genomes and annotations. Based on BUSCO, QUAST a AGAT's spstatistics

busco_mode.description: A flag to set the busco mode. Either genome, proteins, transcriptome

busco_lineage.description: A flag to set the busco lineage, default:auto

busco_lineages_path.description: A flag to set the BUSCO lineages directory

busco_config.description: A path to a BUSCO config file (optional)

go_max_plot.description: Choose number of rows to plot in GO figure

go_algo.description: topGO algorithm and statistic combination (classic_fisher, weight01_fisher, weight01_t, elim_ks, weight_ks). The GO input is a gene membership list, so only the Fisher-based options (classic_fisher, weight01_fisher) produce results; the score-based t/ks options require per-gene scores and yield empty tables with this input.

orthofinder_v2.description: Use OrthoFinder v2.5.5 instead of v3.1.3. Recommended for large datasets where v3 stalls or fails.

orthofinder_method.description: OrthoFinder gene tree inference method (-M). 'msa' additionally writes MultipleSequenceAlignments/, which --iqtree_species_tree requires.

orthofinder_tree.description: OrthoFinder gene tree inference program (-T). Requires --orthofinder_method msa. Note this sets the per-orthogroup gene tree method inside OrthoFinder; to build the species tree from a concatenated supermatrix instead, use --iqtree_species_tree.

iqtree_species_tree.description: Infer the species tree with IQ-TREE2 from a concatenated (supermatrix) alignment of the single-copy orthogroups, instead of using OrthoFinder's own STAG/STRIDE tree. The alignments OrthoFinder already produced are concatenated into a supermatrix with one partition per orthogroup, IQ-TREE2 fits a model per partition (-m MFP) with 1000 ultrafast bootstrap and SH-aLRT replicates, and the resulting tree is rooted and used for every CAFE5 stage. The single-copy orthogroups are aligned with MAFFT by the pipeline, so this works with any --orthofinder_method. Cannot be combined with --input_tree/--input_orthogroups.

iqtree_outgroup.description: Comma-separated tip name(s) used to root the IQ-TREE2 species tree, e.g. 'Apis_mellifera' or 'Apis_mellifera,Bombus_terrestris'. The named taxa must form a monophyletic group in the inferred tree, otherwise the run fails. When not set the tree is midpoint-rooted instead. Only used with --iqtree_species_tree.

iqtree_args.description: Extra arguments appended to the IQ-TREE2 command line, e.g. '--gcf gene_trees.nwk' or '-m LG+F+G4' to override model selection. Only used with --iqtree_species_tree.

tree_scale_factor.description: Scaling factor multiplied across all branch lengths by rescale_tree.py before CAFE5. chronoMPL() in cafe_prep.R then makes the result ultrametric. Default 1000 prevents numerical precision issues in CAFE5. Ignored when --input_tree_is_dated is set.

input_tree_is_dated.description: Treat --input_tree as an already time-calibrated, ultrametric tree (branch lengths in millions of years) and pass it to every CAFE5 stage unchanged: RESCALE_TREE is skipped, chronoMPL() is skipped, and no branch-length rescaling is applied (effectively --tree_scale_factor 1). cafe_prep.R validates that the tree is rooted, binary, ultrametric, has positive branch lengths, and that its leaf set exactly matches the (subset) gene-count columns.

cafe_zero_root.description: Pass CAFE5's -z/--zero_root option to every CAFE5 call (base, error-model, k-sweep, best-model and large-family runs), retaining families inferred to have zero copies at the analysis root. CAFE5 does not generally recommend this; use as a sensitivity analysis alongside the default run.

orthofinder_msa_dir.description: OrthoFinder MultipleSequenceAlignments/ directory (per-orthogroup *.fa). When provided together with --orthofinder_genetree_dir, the alignments and gene trees of HOGs significantly expanded at the focus node(s) are copied into the results.

cafe_focus_clades.description: Comma-separated CAFE internal node label(s) of interest (as shown in cafe_node_label_guide.pdf), OR one or more '|'-separated tip-species sets whose MRCA defines a node (robust to CAFE renumbering nodes per run), e.g. 'Vespula_vulgaris,Vespa_crabro|Polistes_dominula,Vespula_vulgaris'. Used to extract alignments/gene trees of significantly expanded families.

cafe_max_differential.description: Maximum gene count differential (max-min copies) threshold for CAFE filtering on retry. Vizueta et al. 2025 used 20.

eggnog_data_dir.description: Path to pre-downloaded EggNOG database directory. If null, database will be downloaded automatically.

eggnog_tax_scope.description: Taxonomic scope for eggNOG OG level selection (e.g. 50557 for Insecta, or comma-separated list '50557,7399')

eggnog_target_taxa.description: Restrict eggNOG-mapper to orthologs from this taxon and descendants (NCBI taxon ID)

eggnog_rep_species.description: Species ID to use as the representative when building the OG annotation summary. If unset, the species with the most annotated genes is chosen automatically.

cafe_max_k.description: Maximum number of gamma rate categories (k) to test in CAFE5 model selection.
